g.data-latex: \begin{align*} e^{+} &= \lfloor x_{\text{IS}} - x_{\text{CA1}}\rfloor_{+} \\ e^{-} &= \lfloor x_{\text{CA1}} - x_{\text{IS}}\rfloor_{+} \\ \delta^{+} &= \alpha \left(e^{+} \cdot x^{T}_{\text{CA3}}\right)\left(1-W(t)\right) \\ \delta^{-} &= \alpha \left(e^{-} \cdot x^{T}_{\text{CA3}}\right)W(t) \\ W(t+1) &= \delta^{+} - \delta^{-} + W(t) \end{align*}
